post.description: `admitted` exactly once per ticket, however many scanners try at the same moment. After that, `duplicate` with the time it was first used.

Scans are applied in the order they were made. The earliest scan of a ticket is the admission; the rest are recorded as duplicates. Each scan has an id chosen by the scanner, so uploading a batch twice is harmless.
